record.measurement_method: DC method on symmetric Li/C/LPSCl/C/Li cells
record.evidence_quote: Li-KB has Li ionic conductivity values of 18.1, 25.8, 41.1, 53.2 and 69.6 mS cm-1 at 25, 40, 60, 80 and 100 oC, respectively.
record.notes: Room-temperature value of the lithiated Ketjen Black interlayer, an effective ionic conductivity derived from DC resistance of carbon interlayers in symmetric cells (not a bulk electrolyte). The same 18.1 mS cm-1 value is also stated in the abstract. Activation energy 0.17 eV is stated in the text for Li-KB. Only the room-temperature value is recorded per the instructions; the Arrhenius series is skipped.
